plugins.name: atlanai
plugins.description: Your organization's skills, agents, knowledge and MCP servers, from the Atlan registry. One sign-in, no API key.

plugins.name: atlanai-analytics
plugins.description: Answer data questions from governed metrics, use and draft your business ontology, bootstrap metrics and saved SQL queries, build a talk-to-data agent, evaluate it and improve it against your Snowflake or Databricks warehouse, on the Atlan registry.

plugins.name: atlanai-mods
plugins.description: Claude Code mod for the Atlan registry: registry reads run without a prompt, writes ask first, archive and move show what depends on the artifact, Atlan calls read as one line in the transcript, a pane lists what the session touched, a band follows a skill publish, /atlan skills picks a skill to load, and the status line reports a broken Atlan connection.
